text: Could you add something catchy to this latte pic for a café post? I always overthink these little posts, so I would really appreciate help with the wording. You can pick the exact words, and somewhere in all my fussing I should mention that the post needs to be square and the line should be short, warm, and in English. I just worry about making a nice coffee photo feel too busy. Please keep the coffee and the leaf art visible, and don’t add a logo or any extra sales information.
